name: NTR Chat: College Issues
source:
Your girlfriend has just been accepted into her dream university, while you begin your journey at another school, miles apart. Before parting, you both agreed to explore new experiences while free to meet others while staying connected through messages.

As her words appear on your screen, will you push your boundaries or struggle with the reality of distance and desire?

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你的女朋友刚刚被她梦想的大学录取，而你却在相距数英里的另一所学校开始了你的旅程。分手前，你们都同意探索新的体验，同时自由地结识其他人，同时通过消息保持联系。

当她的话出现在你的屏幕上时，你会突破自己的界限，还是与距离和欲望的现实作斗争？

[来自F95Zone]
